function-grapher.name: Function Grapher
function-grapher.description: Plot algebraic/trig/parametric functions, points, vertical asymptotes/lines, tangents, and shaded integrals on a Cartesian plane.

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

inequality-grapher.name: Inequality Grapher
inequality-grapher.description: Shade 2D linear, nonlinear, or complex loci inequalities and feasible regions.

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

number-line.name: Number Line
number-line.description: Plot 1D intervals and inequalities with open/closed endpoints and arrows on a number line.

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

box-plots.name: Box Plots
box-plots.description: Create single or parallel comparative box-and-whisker plots from 5-number summaries or raw data with optional Tukey outliers.

rawData.description: Optional comma-separated numbers; auto-computes 5-number summary & outliers

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

histograms.name: Histograms
histograms.description: Generate frequency histograms from raw numerical data or grouped bin intervals.

rawData.description: Comma-separated string or array of numbers

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

scatter-plots.name: Scatter Plots
scatter-plots.description: Plot bivariate (x, y) scatter data with optional linear regression line of best fit and residual views.

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

stem-and-leaf.name: Stem & Leaf Plot
stem-and-leaf.description: Create ordered single or back-to-back stem-and-leaf plots with split stems, keys, counts, and quartile highlights.

data2.description: Optional left-hand dataset for back-to-back plot

visual-quartiles.name: Visual Quartiles
visual-quartiles.description: Display an ordered list of numbers with visual circle/split annotations showing Q1, Median, and Q3.

rawData.description: Dataset as comma-separated string or number array

pie-charts.name: Pie Charts
pie-charts.description: Create pie or donut charts with percentage/value/combined labels, exploded slices, and legends.

segmented-bar-charts.name: Segmented Bar Charts
segmented-bar-charts.description: Create stacked / percentage segmented bar charts with patterns and legends.

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

bar-charts.name: Bar Charts
bar-charts.description: Create single-series or grouped column/bar charts with optional value labels and legends.

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

dot-plots.name: Dot Plots
dot-plots.description: Create statistical dot plots from frequency rows or raw numbers, with optional quartile markers and column totals.

rawData.description: Optional raw numbers; auto-tallied into dots

config.description: Optional partial GraphConfig overrides for axes, grid, labels, and styling.

frequency-tables.name: Frequency Tables
frequency-tables.description: Generate clean publication-ready frequency and tally mark tables with optional total row and student worksheet mode.

rawData.description: Optional raw values auto-counted into rows

network-grapher.name: Network Grapher
network-grapher.description: Create weighted/unweighted, directed/undirected graphs & networks from node/edge lists or adjacency matrices with automatic label optimization.

venn-diagrams.name: Venn Diagrams
venn-diagrams.description: Create 1-, 2-, or 3-set Venn diagrams with region counts/probabilities, shading, custom set labels, and optional 2-way companion table.

regions.description: Map of bitmask (0=outside, 1=A only, 2=B only, 3=A∩B, 4=C only, 5=A∩C, 6=B∩C, 7=A∩B∩C) to string value or region object

tree-diagrams.name: Tree Diagrams
tree-diagrams.description: Generate multi-stage probability tree diagrams in bag-draw (with/without replacement) or custom-branch mode.

shape-builder.name: Shape Builder
shape-builder.description: Render 2D, composite, and 3D geometric figures (triangles, quadrilaterals, circles/sectors, L-shapes, prisms, cylinders, cones, spheres, pyramids) with dimension & angle labels.

preset.description: Preset ID or name search e.g. "right-triangle", "isosceles", "cylinder", "cone", "prism", "l-shape", "sector"

labels.description: Optional replacement label strings mapped in order onto the preset/default shape labels

shapes.description: Full ShapeDef array for advanced customization

box-builder.name: Box Builder
box-builder.description: Render worksheet equations, fractions, and matrices containing fillable answer boxes (\box, \mat).

equations.description: Array of LaTeX strings with \box placeholders e.g. "$y = \box x + \box$"
